title: 从无到有：语言模型能否发现“零”的概念？
summary: 本研究以简单算术为例，探讨现代AI模型能否独立发现“零”的概念。结果表明，GPT-2规模的语言模型在测试时无法完成此泛化，但通过少量示例训练后可显著提升，且语言预训练可将所需示例减少约50%。
summary_en: This study uses simple arithmetic to examine whether modern AI models can independently discover the concept of 'zero'. Results show that GPT-2-sized language models fail at test-time generalization but improve substantially after few-shot training, with language pretraining reducing required examples by ~50%.
